plan.goal: Implement the full play runtime: load a book → hero creation → traverse nodes → resolve actions (décor/PNJ/piège/monstre) → manage inventory/equipment → track health/endurance/XP → save progress. All orchestration decisions are sourced from REGLES-PLAY-A-COMPLETER.md (completed 2026-06-22); that file is the canonical complement to REGLES-DU-JEU.md for play mode.
plan.design_reference: REGLES-DU-JEU.md (math) + genliv_game_system_pack/REGLES-PLAY-A-COMPLETER.md (orchestration). Play mode is a separate app surface from the editor; the editor must never call play resolvers (KR-131).
acceptance_criteria: A1 — Game starts at the `sommaire` node; its text is displayed first.
A2 — Each screen resolves its required action (décor / PNJ / piège / monstre) before showing outgoing choice buttons; the player may use one object per action phase.
A3 — `choice` edges with `prereq` are hidden when the hero does not own the referenced object; `choice` edges with `countdown` auto-redirect to `fallback` after delay seconds (only while visible).
A4 — Each node transition (screen change) awards +5 PE to the hero.
A5 — Nodes with `endVictory` show a victory screen; `endFailure` shows a failure screen; the `mort` node = game over.

B1 — Hero generation: computer rolls 2D4 per carac; player distributes a +1D4 bonus pool freely across any caracs of their choice (not restricted to 3, cap 10 per carac at creation); rolled results are assignable to any carac in any order.
B2 — Player may request 1 global re-roll (new 2D4 + 1D4 bonus round, again fully assignable); only 1 re-roll allowed per session start.
B3 — Hero starts with mains nues (×0.3 weapon multiplier), no armor, no shield, 0 objects; all equipment must come from the book.
B4 — Starting PE courant = EN (full endurance gauge).
B5 — Player enters a name (cosmetic, no gameplay effect).
C1 — Inventory is unlimited (no item cap).
C2 — Hero carries multiple weapons but only 1 is active at a time; switching active weapon from inventory costs 1 combat round (no attack that round).
C3 — Hero may wear 1 armor and 1 shield simultaneously (shield stacks with armor reduction); equipping a 2-handed weapon while wearing a shield is blocked.
C4 — Ranged ammo is unlimited (no tracking).
C5 — Object reinforcement bonus (author-defined) applies to the relevant action outcome (e.g. reduced trap damage, reinforced combat).
D1 — Both combatants choose posture simultaneously each round; AT is computed for both; higher AT wins the assault; AT tie = null round (no damage, replay).
D2 — Monster posture AI baseline: 60 % Normale / 25 % Précise / 15 % Défensive; shifts to 40 % Défensive when monster PV < 25 % of max.

D3 — Monster flee behavior is driven by creatureType (KR-135): humanoid flees at 25 % PV (MC roll, TC = 1 + ΔT); undead never flee; animal at 50 % PV / giant-animal at 40 % PV (50/50 chance); magic creature at 10 % PV (MC roll, TC = ΔT; ΔT = 0 → never flees).

D4 — Both hero AND monster lose 1 PE per round (§ D4). Monster peMax = stats.EN; monster PE starts full. Mort-vivants and creatures with 'pas d'endurance' are immune (immuneToFatigue: true on their CREATURE_TYPES descriptor → no PE gauge, no fatigue malus). Other creature types with this capacité handled in MONSTER_CAPACITIES (iter 4).
D5 — Hero flee: attempted at start of round; monster deals 1 free assault (Normal posture vs hero Defensive); hero then moves to `fleeTarget`; impossible if `fleeTarget` is absent.
D6 — Critical hit degrades the target's armor by 1 for the rest of the book (applies to hero AND monster; tracked in session state).
D7 — Monster at 0 PV → victoryTarget node + loot granted + XP awarded. Hero PV ≤ -CA → mort node.
D8 — V1: 1 monster per combat screen; Hobgobelin 'en groupe' MC=5 capacity is ignored.
E1 — Unconscious (0 ≥ PV > -CA): in combat, monster deals 1 last assault; if hero PV then ≤ -CA → mort; otherwise hero wakes at 1 PV after combat ends. Out of combat → mort.
E2 — Potion restores PV to max AND PE to max; potions are book objects; usage unlimited while possessed.
E3 — PE recovery: only +5 per screen transition; no passive regen.

E4 — PNJ gift effect 'pv' = immediate heal X PV (capped at max PV); 'attaque' = permanent +X to hero AT floor; 'defense' = permanent +X to armor reduction; 'scenario' = plot object, no numeric effect.
F1 — V1: skill rolls (TC challenges) appear only on traps and décor 'prendre' objects; choice-gated rolls are out of scope.
F2 — XP shop accessible at any time via a persistent 'Progression' screen; no gating by location or rest.
F3 — XP awarded immediately after a challenge success or combat win.
F4 — Upgrading a carac increases PV max; current PV gains the same difference (implicit partial heal).

G1 — Session save state: current node id + hero snapshot (caracs, PV/PE/XP, MC bonus) + inventory (all objects by id) + active weapon/armor/shield + visited-node set (node ids where an object was taken or a monster was defeated, anti-farm).
G2 — Visited-node set: an object already taken from a node cannot be taken again; a monster already defeated on a node does not re-trigger.
G3 — 1 auto-save per book (keyed by book id); 'Continuer' resumes from save.

H — All 23 monster capacités resolve as coded play effects via a MONSTER_CAPACITIES registry (KR-133/KR-117); each maps a capacity id to a { trigger, apply } descriptor. The `capacity` string on MonsterConfig identifies the variant.

H-bis — `magic: n` on EquipmentEffect.arme adds n to both MC (before AT) and PF_base (before écart × posture). `silver: true` bypasses armour for monsters whose MONSTER_CAPACITIES descriptor carries `bypassedBySilver: true` (Loup-Garou). No if/switch on templateId.

brain_contracts.name: PlaySessionService
brain_contracts.note: Owns the mutable hero + session state; persists via PersistenceService per-book (KR-134). Never mutates the book itself.

brain_contracts.name: CombatEngine (brain/combatEngine.ts)
brain_contracts.note: Pure, RNG-injectable: resolveRound, pickMonsterPosture, resolveMonsterFlee. Reads CREATURE_TYPES registry, not if/switch (KR-135).

brain_contracts.name: MONSTER_CAPACITIES
brain_contracts.note: KR-133: maps each monster capacity id to { trigger: CapacitéTrigger, apply: CapacitéEffect }. Play runtime dispatches through it.

brain_contracts.name: CREATURE_TYPES
brain_contracts.note: KR-135: maps CreatureType → { fleeThresholdPct, fleeStrategy, postureBias, passiveFlags }.

plan.walking_skeleton: Load a book → render sommaire text → show outgoing choices (no filtering yet) → clicking a choice navigates to the next node → +5 PE applied → basic hero state (caracs generated, PV=FO+AG+EN, PE=EN) persisted → one auto-save per book. Combat/action resolution and character creation screen deferred to later iterations.

iterations.goal: Game loop skeleton + save/load: sommaire start, node traversal, +5 PE per transition, basic choice buttons, save/load session (current node + hero caracs + PV/PE). endVictory/endFailure/mort screens.

Character creation screen: 2D4 per carac + 1D4 assignable to 3 chosen caracs, 1 re-roll, name input. Inventory + equipment management: unlimited inventory, 1 active weapon/armor, shield stacking, 2H+shield incompatibility, switching weapon costs a combat round.

Combat engine: simultaneous posture resolution, monster AI (CREATURE_TYPES registry, posture weights + flee thresholds by creatureType), hero flee, unconscious/mort states, loot grant, XP award, armor degradation on critical, -1 PE per round for hero AND monster.

Monster capacités: MONSTER_CAPACITIES registry with { trigger, apply } descriptors for all 23 monsters; combat loop dispatches through registry. Magic/silver weapon flags applied in pfBase + armour bypass.

Full action resolution: décor (prendre + skill roll + object reinforcement), PNJ (gift effects pv/attaque/defense/scenario), piège (PE cost + fatal variant). XP shop (anytime), carac upgrade → PV max diff healed. prereq + countdown choice filtering.
Object reinforcement (AC C5): author assigns rollBonus on any GameObject; player picks 0 or 1 applicable object before a trap or décor prendre roll; bonus adds to effective carac value (KR-141).

known_risks: KR-133 — MONSTER CAPACITÉS AS PLAY REGISTRY: capacités must be a KR-117 registry (MONSTER_CAPACITIES) mapping each capacity id to { trigger: CapacitéTrigger, apply: CapacitéEffect } — never an if/switch in the combat loop. Adding a capacité effect = one new registry entry, zero consumer edits.

KR-134 — SESSION SAVE STATE: play session persists via PersistenceService with per-book key `genliv:play:session:{bookId}` (registered in persistenceKeys.ts, KR-011). State includes the visited-node set for anti-farm. Battle transients (current-round state) are NOT persisted; saves happen only at node transitions.

KR-135 — CREATURE TYPE DRIVES AI: `creatureType` on MonsterStatBlock is a KR-117 registry key (CREATURE_TYPES) whose descriptor carries flee threshold %, flee strategy (roll-based / chance / never), posture-weight overrides at low HP, and passive trait flags (e.g. immuneToFatigue). Never infer creature type from name or capacity text. Bestiary seeds the correct type for all 23 canonical monsters.

KR-136 — MAGIC AND SILVER WEAPON MODIFIERS: `magic: n` on EquipmentEffect.arme adds n to wielder MC (before AT computation) AND n to PF_base (before écart × posture multiplier). `silver: true` sets the target's effective armour to 0, ONLY for monsters whose MONSTER_CAPACITIES descriptor includes `bypassedBySilver: true`. Never check templateId or name at call sites.
KR-131 (re-assert) — Editor must never call play resolvers. PlaySessionService and CombatEngine are play-only; importing them from any editor feature is a violation of the authoring/play seam.

KR-117 (re-assert) — Every closed set introduced by play mode (CreatureType, CapacitéTrigger, flee strategies) must be a registry with descriptor data + eventual behaviour fields. No if/switch at call sites.

KR-141 — OBJECT REINFORCEMENT (AC C5): ReinforcementBonus.rollBonus on a GameObject adds to the hero's effective characteristic value for a skill roll (trap or décor prendre). The player picks 0 or 1 object before the roll; `rollBonus` is the 4th param on resolveTrap/resolveTakeableRoll (after `rng`, default 0) so existing test signatures need no update. TrapScreen: if trap.roll exists, start in pick phase (result=null); resolve on 'Affronter' click. DecorScreen: ReinforcementPicker above object list; rollBonus injected into resolveTakeableRoll per click. ObjectEditor: Stepper 0–5 for rollBonus (authored in brain/components, KR-052). Author sets reinforcementBonus on any GameObject; the play runtime only reads it.

iterations_log.label: walking-skeleton + iter-1
architecture_choices: src/player/ is a hard isolation boundary: imports only pure brain/ modules (characteristics, challenge, xp, combat, equipment, monsterCapacities, playExport types) — never BookService, PersistenceService, EventBus, or any feature (KR-131).

AdventureDocument = PlayExport (type alias in player/types.ts); buildAdventureDocument(book) in brain/utils/ is a pass-through over exportBookForPlay — no separate type invented (confirmed architecture decision).

Session persistence uses window.localStorage directly in player/utils/persist.ts (not PersistenceService) for extractibility. Key prefix 'genliv:play:session:' is mirrored in persistenceKeys.ts as PLAY_SESSION_KEY_PREFIX for auditability (KR-134).
PlayerModal lives in features/play-mode/ (editor integration), not in player/ (which stays runtime-only). EditorScreen is the composition root wiring both.
Hero is auto-rolled (2D4 per carac) on 'Nouvelle partie'; character creation screen deferred to iter 2.

sessionEngine.ts is pure (no React, no state): createSession, navigate, listChoices, determinePhase all take immutable inputs and return new objects. usePlaySession hook owns React state and auto-save side effects.
deviations_from_plan: Walking skeleton and iter 1 shipped together (identical scope — both cover sommaire start, node traversal, +5 PE, save/load, end screens).

test_coverage.unit: heroGen (rollHeroCaracs, defaultHero, pvMax/peMax derivation), sessionEngine (findSommaire, listChoices, determinePhase, navigate PE cap), persist (round-trip, key isolation, clearSession) — 33 tests

iterations_log.label: iter-2: character creation + equipment state
architecture_choices: charCreation.ts is pure (no React, RNG-injectable): rollCreationPool, emptyAssignment, isAssignmentComplete, baseValue, totalValue, buildHeroFromCreation. All creation math lives here.
Assignment uses rollIndices (index into rolls[], not values) so duplicate roll values (e.g. two 5s) remain independently assignable without ambiguity.
UsePlayRuntimePhase = 'start' | 'creating' | 'playing' in usePlaySession splits the runtime into three phases; CharacterCreationScreen only mounts during 'creating'.
rerollUsed tracked as local useState in PlayerRuntime (not in the hook) — it is pure UI state for the creation phase, not session data.
SessionState extended with inventory/activeWeapon/activeProtection/activeShield/armorDegradation; loadSession() applies defaults for sessions saved before iter 2 (migration guard).
CREATION_CAP = 10: per-carac cap at creation = base (roll) + bonus ≤ 10.
deviations_from_plan: Inventory + equipment management fields are tracked in SessionState but not yet exposed as a UI — that screen comes with iter 3+ (combat/loot). The state is ready; the display is deferred.

test_coverage.unit: charCreation (rollCreationPool, emptyAssignment, isAssignmentComplete, baseValue, totalValue, buildHeroFromCreation, CREATION_CAP), sessionEngine (createSessionFromHero, default equipment fields), persist (migration from pre-iter-2 sessions) — 58 tests total

iterations_log.label: iter-3: combat engine
architecture_choices: CREATURE_TYPES registry in brain/creatureTypes.ts (KR-135): maps each CreatureType to flee threshold, flee strategy, posture weights, lowHp weights, immuneToFatigue. Drives monster AI; never branched on by string (KR-117).
combatEngine.ts is pure (no React, RNG-injectable): startCombat, pickMonsterPosture, resolveCombatRound, tryHeroFlee. All orchestration rules (D1–D8, E1, I) implemented here.
Monster PE gauge: peMax = stats.EN, pe starts full, -1 per round unless immuneToFatigue. Mort-vivants have peMax=0 and skip PE drain entirely.
Garde aiguisée (D2-bis): consecutiveDefWins counter per combatant; at 3, opponent gets +2 MC (gardeBonus) for the rest of combat, counter resets.
freeAssault() shared helper for flee penalty (D5) and E1 last-monster-assault; always monster Normale vs hero Défensive with forced postures.
hero-survived-unconscious outcome for E1 survival (hero at 1 PV, node marked visited, combat ends without death).
pendingXp computed in combatEngine on victory/monster-fled; stored in CombatState for the hook to read without re-computing.
CombatScreen uses key={combatNodeId} in PlayerRuntime to force remount on new combat node.
useCombat dispatches callbacks via useEffect+endFiredRef guard (fires exactly once when outcome flips from ongoing).
deviations_from_plan: Spec AC D4 corrected: monsters DO have a PE gauge (peMax = EN), only immuneToFatigue types skip it. Previous session wrote 'monsters do not have PE' in error.

test_coverage.unit: combatEngine: 24 tests — startCombat, pickMonsterPosture, resolveCombatRound (tie, PE drain, monster PE, guard, log, victory), tryHeroFlee (survived/died/log/phase). Total test suite: 404 tests.

iterations_log.label: iter-4: CAPACITY_HOOKS registry — 23 capacités + magic/silver
architecture_choices: combatTypes.ts extracted as a shared type file (CombatState, MonsterInstance, CombatEffectsState, etc.) to avoid circular imports between combatEngine.ts and capacityEffects.ts.

CAPACITY_HOOKS: Record<MonsterCapacityId, CapacityHooks> in player/engine/capacityEffects.ts. Every hook is a pure function; the registry is the only dispatch point — zero if/switch on capacity strings (KR-133).

CombatEffectsState tracks per-combat transient state (poisonRoundsLeft, renversementMalus, seismeStunned, disarmedThisRound, fureurUsed, zombieRevived, etreinte, piquesUsed, soinsBloques). Cleared correctly at round start.

Magic bonus (KR-136): activeMagicBonus on SessionEquipmentState; added to hero MC; zeroed when disarmedThisRound. Mirror guard applied in both combatEngine.heroMcEffective and capacityEffects.heroMcForHooks.

Silver bypass (KR-136): bypassedBySilver on MonsterInstance (sourced from MONSTER_CAPACITIES descriptor). When monster.bypassedBySilver && session.activeSilverWeapon → monster armour = 0 in combat engine.

Post-combat mutations (maladie EN drain, rayon PVmax drain, vol inventory removal) stored on CombatState as pendingEnMaxDelta/pendingPvMaxDelta/pendingVol, propagated through useCombat.onVictory to usePlaySession.finishCombat.
enMaxDelta applied to hero.peMax only (V1 approximation — full EN carac mutation would cascade to pvMax + fatigue thresholds, deferred to V2).
vol-de-vie heals full damage dealt (= damage), not half — matches MONSTER_CAPACITIES descriptor 'Récupère autant de PV qu''il inflige' (BUG-011 caught in self-review).
deviations_from_plan: Plan said 'magic: n adds n to PF_base' but implementation adds n only to hero MC (activeMagicBonus on session). PF_base integration deferred — changing pfBase would require passing activeMagicBonus through the PF computation chain. AC H-bis partially met: MC addend is done; PF addend is open_question for iter 5.

test_coverage.unit: capacityEffects.test.ts: 35 tests — aucune, maladie, vol, se-releve, chant-stressant, poison (trigger + DoT), renversement, etreinte (counter/double/kill/reset), intangible (cap/magic bypass/zero), insensible (damageFactor/soinsBloques), magie/rayon (armour bypass), regeneration, vol-de-vie. Total suite: 439 tests, 44 suites.

iterations_log.label: iter-5: full action resolution + XP shop + choice filtering
architecture_choices: actionEngine.ts: pure function layer (no React, no state, RNG-injectable) — resolveTrap, resolveDecorReveal, resolveTakeableRoll, applyPnjGift, autoEquipObject, computeCaracUpgrade, applyCaracUpgrade, computeMcUpgrade, applyMcUpgrade. Zero imports from features/.
PnjGiftMutations: additive delta struct (pvDelta, mcBonusDelta, armorBonusDelta, inventoryAdd); calling hook applies with prev + delta — avoids passing current session to actionEngine.

autoEquipObject: checks current session equipment state to determine if slot is vacant; weapon slot vacant when activeWeapon === DEFAULT_WEAPON; shield uses bouclier descriptor's shieldDefensiveBonus flag.

permanentArmorBonus on SessionEquipmentState (not HeroState): keeps hero creation unchanged; stacks with equipped armor in heroArmourEffective in both combatEngine and capacityEffects (already wired in iter 5 start).
filterChoicesByPrereq in sessionEngine.ts: called from listChoices so all callers get filtered results. Empty objectId → hide (safe default for unconfigured prereqs).
ChoiceList.tsx: CountdownChoice sub-component isolates timer per-edge; uses lazy useState init for delay + fallback, with the delay/fallback in useEffect dep array to restart if they change.
TrapScreen uses lazy useState initializer (resolveTrap on first render only); no useEffect needed — removes the exhaustive-deps concern entirely.
DecorScreen resolves reveal via lazy useState; uses per-object TakeState map so multiple takeables can be attempted independently.
XpShopScreen: bottom-sheet modal overlay with role=dialog; Progression button only shown on NodeScreen (not combat/action screens).
EN upgrade also increments peMax (peMax = EN per heroGen; caught by tech-lead review as F-1 major bug).
KR-137: permanentArmorBonus is session equipment state, not hero state — survives combat without touching hero caracs.
KR-138: prereq filtering is canonical in sessionEngine.listChoices — no caller needs to filter independently.
KR-139: countdown timer safety — delay + fallback as dep array primitives in useEffect; onChoiceRef stable ref for callback.
--overlay CSS token added to colors.css for modal backdrop scrim (nit from tech-lead review).
deviations_from_plan: C5 object reinforcement still deferred — schema blocked on design decision.
magic: n PF_base addend (AC H-bis) still deferred — MC addend only.
Equipment screen (inventory browser, weapon switching) deferred beyond iter 5.
piège does not cost PE (no PE cost mechanic in current spec) — fatal variant fully implemented.

Révélation reveal roll result for écouter/fouiller resolved via lazy useState (one stable random result per mount); React Strict Mode double-invocation in dev produces a different result but still mechanically valid.

test_coverage.unit: actionEngine.test.ts: 48 tests — resolveTrap (all branches), resolveDecorReveal (ungated/gated/fallback), resolveTakeableRoll (success/fail/xp), applyPnjGift (pv/attaque/defense/scenario), autoEquipObject (weapon/magic/silver/armor/shield/no-op), computeCaracUpgrade (upgrade/cap/pvMaxDelta/peMaxDelta), applyCaracUpgrade (pvMax/pv/peMax/xp), computeMcUpgrade (gate/cap), applyMcUpgrade. sessionEngine.test.ts: 3 new tests for filterChoicesByPrereq (satisfied/unsatisfied/empty objectId). Total suite: 487 tests, 45 suites.

iterations_log.label: iter-6: object reinforcement (AC C5, KR-141)
architecture_choices: ReinforcementBonus interface added to brain/types.ts; reinforcementBonus?: field added to GameObject. Schema is additive — existing books load unchanged.

ObjectEditor (brain/components/ObjectEditor.tsx): Stepper 0–5 for BONUS DE JET; onChange sets reinforcementBonus = { rollBonus: v } when v > 0, clears to undefined when v = 0 to keep clean serialisation.
rollBonus added as 4th param (after rng, default 0) to resolveRoll, resolveTrap, resolveTakeableRoll — preserves all existing test call signatures without change.

TrapScreen: if trap.roll exists, start in pick phase (result = null); ReinforcementPicker renders; 'Affronter le piège' button resolves with rollBonus on click. Auto-skips pick phase when trap has no roll (auto-échec branch).

ReinforcementPicker (NEW src/player/components/): renders only when inventory contains applicable objects (rollBonus > 0). Toggle-selection pattern — clicking the active choice deselects it. Returns null when no applicable objects (callers render nothing).

DecorScreen: ReinforcementPicker rendered above object list for prendre only; rollBonus threaded into resolveTakeableRoll per Prendre click. session.inventory and adventure.objects already on existing props.
PlayerRuntime: passes inventory={session.inventory} and adventureObjects={adventure.objects} to TrapScreen (new props added in iter 6).

test_coverage.unit: actionEngine.test.ts: 2 new rollBonus tests (resolveTrap lifts borderline fail, resolveTakeableRoll increments characteristicValue). ObjectEditor.test.tsx: 1 new test (reinforcementBonus Stepper + persisted via onChange). Total suite: 491 tests, 45 suites.

open_questions: Fire/acid damage source (Troll capacity): REGLES-PLAY says not V1. If modelled later, needs a new EquipmentEffect kind or object flag.
Méduse 'aveugle ou pétrification': questionnaire marks her for removal ('enlever la méduse') — confirm whether she is excluded from V1 or replaced by a simpler capacity.

magic: n PF_base addend (AC H-bis): iter 5 still adds n to MC only; PF_base integration requires threading activeMagicBonus through pfBase() call in combatEngine. Treat MC addend as sufficient for now.
Equipment screen (inventory browser, active weapon/armor switching): deferred beyond iter 5.
